hints.title: Complete Grid Comparison
hints.text: In the tournament grid, grid[i][j] = 1 means team i is strictly stronger than team j.

hints.title: Row Sum Property
hints.text: The overall champion beats all other n - 1 teams.

hints.title: Finding the Maximum
hints.text: Sum each row and return the index i whose row sum equals n - 1.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass row summation over n x n matrix.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining the full matrix is optimal and takes O(n^2).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize row sum = n - 1 condition for undefeated champion.
